theorems.name: Submission.fiw_tb_tda_sub_mass
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (X Pc : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (m + 1)) (u v : Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ), Integrable u → Integrable v → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (m + 1), X ω = ∫ x, u x * (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (m + 1)) x (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (m + 1), Pc ω = ∫ x, v x * (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (m + 1)) x (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))) → ∃ S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (m + 1), (∀ ω, X ω - Pc ω = S ω) ∧ S.mass ≤ ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal |u x - v x|
